# IT Resource Zone

> Free IT learning and exam portal for beginner students, with live exams, practice exams, leaderboards, private progress dashboards, study planning, habit tracking, admin notifications, and curated resources.

- **Developer:** Atif Hasan
- **Live URL:** https://irz.atifhasan.com
- **Stack:** Next.js 15, React 19, MongoDB Atlas, Clerk Auth, Vercel, ImageKit, PostHog, Sentry

## What This App Does

IT Resource Zone helps students prepare and stay consistent with:

- Public listings for live, upcoming, and past IT exams
- Signed-in live and practice exam attempts with answer locking, instant scoring, review, and submission history
- Public global and per-exam leaderboards
- Private student dashboard, profile settings, learning report export, and account deletion
- Personal weekly task planning, daily habit tracking, analytics, and optional browser notifications
- Signed-in resource library with YouTube lessons, PDFs, images, files, and useful links
- Private admin tools for exams, questions, users, resources, categories, assets, and notifications

## Public Pages

| Path | Description |
|------|-------------|
| `/` | Home page for the student portal |
| `/exams` | Published live, upcoming, and past exams |
| `/exam/[id]` | Public exam overview and signed-in exam entry |
| `/leaderboard` | Global leaderboard |
| `/leaderboard/[id]` | Per-exam leaderboard |
| `/privacy` | Privacy Policy |
| `/terms` | Terms of Service |

## Private Or Non-Indexable Areas

| Path | Description |
|------|-------------|
| `/dashboard` | Signed-in learning dashboard and recommendations |
| `/profile` | Student profile, settings, data export, and account deletion |
| `/profile/submission/[id]` | Private submission review |
| `/exams/history` | Private exam history |
| `/tasks` | Personal weekly planner and habit tracker |
| `/tasks/history` | Personal planner and habit analytics |
| `/resources` | Signed-in learning resource library |
| `/resources/[slug]` | Signed-in resource category page |
| `/resources/watch/[slug]` | Signed-in video lesson page |
| `/resources/view/[slug]` | Signed-in resource/file viewer |
| `/sign-in`, `/sign-up` | Authentication screens |
| `/admin` | Private admin panel |
| `/api/*` | API routes |

## Rules And Indexing Notes

- Live exams can enforce one submission per student account.
- Answers are locked once selected.
- Live exam questions are protected until an authorized attempt begins.
- Student profile, dashboard, task, resource, auth, admin, and API routes are private or intentionally non-indexable.
- Public indexing should focus on the home page, exams, exam overview pages, leaderboards, privacy policy, and terms.
